QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] The Miracle Ship
QuestInfo.0: The alien Surana wants to tell you about an exciting opportunity to level up quickly and see the world while you're at it!
QuestInfo.1: The Matter Transducer is a teleportation device contained within the Eluna Express. You can use it to travel anywhere on Maple World instantly! Use it to travel to Henesys.
QuestInfo.2: You saw how wonderful life was with a Matter Transducer. This should greatly enhance the efficiency of your leveling.
QuestInfo.demandSummary:

#questorder2#Travel to Henesys (#R63660ExheRef63602#)
#questorder3#Return to the Eluna Express (#R63660ExreRef63602#)

default.0: Don't worry, the Matter Transducer won't scatter your molecules. That rarely ever happens anymore.\r\n
